profile.headline: Senior Software Developer looking for Remote/Hybrid roles in the Baltimore metropolitan area
profile.summary: Senior Software Developer with 10+ years of experience creating and supporting multiple Army application systems and projects now looking for work in the private sector.

positions.title: Software Developer T3
positions.description:
Created APIs and expanded user functionality for a simulation program running on Unreal Engine 5 with a C# frontend.

Containerized the deployment of and rewrote the Python frontend of a program in React, Typescript, Vite, and Rust. 

Wrote an inventory management system in React, Typescript, and Vite.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Python (Programming Language) · Vue.js · Rust (Programming Language) · TypeScript · React.js · Containerization

positions.title: Sr. Applications Development Engineer
positions.locationName: Aberdeen Proving Ground, Maryland, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Senior software engineer for the Command Post of the Future (CPOF), which is a United States Army C2 software system that allows commanders to maintain topsight over the battlefield; collaborate with superiors, peers and subordinates over live data; and communicate their intent with other commanders in the same area of operations.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Jira · Management · Reasoning Skills · Git · VMware · XML

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
Created and maintained tactical networks. Supplied voice and data services using Cisco products. Troubleshoot every problem that arose to sustain network connectivity and ensure the least amount of downtime for my customers.
•	Received an award for providing voice and data services to over 50 users while deployed to Qatar in 2013-2014 resulting in 100% secure and reliable communication to the rest of the Middle East Theater of Operations. 
•	Received an award for helping with the tactical withdraw from Iraq in 2011 resulting in 100% integral services which aided in the successful withdraw of the United States military servicemen and women. 
•	Maintained accountability of $5 million of equipment and passed inspection standards with a 100% pass rate.

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
Created and maintained tactical networks. Supplied voice and data services using Cisco products. Troubleshot every problem that arose to sustain network connectivity so as to ensure the least amount of downtime for my customers.
•	Received an award for providing voice and data services during the reaction to the Pyeongtaek Port South Korean Naval sinking in the summer of 2010 resulting in uninterrupted communication services to the Admiral conducting the investigation.
•	Trained 5 other personnel on the workings and procedures of the network systems resulting in an 80% increase in efficiency of network emplacement procedures.
